transcript.text: Alright everyone, let's get the weekly access-control review started. We've got the passkey-authentication rollout for the internal administrator console scheduled for Monday at 09:00. Before I can approve the production rollout plan, I need to go through the checklist with each of you individually. I'll call on the identity platform lead, IT operations lead, and compliance engineer one at a time. For each of you, I need you to state any rollout-impacting findings, the exact plan changes you require, and the follow-up you will own. I won't approve the plan until each role has completed that check-in. Let's start with the identity platform lead — what findings do you have?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: While testing an unrelated mobile-device enrollment issue this morning, I confirmed that 23 legacy mobile clients cannot complete the passkey ceremony. The identity platform team requires a 10% canary and a 14-day optional-mode period before enforcement. I have not updated the rollout ticket yet.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: While preparing the weekly administrator access roster, I confirmed that 18 contractor accounts do not receive their required hardware keys until Wednesday at 09:00. IT Operations must exclude those accounts from enrollment until that time, but I have not added the exception list to the rollout plan yet.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: During a control-evidence review this afternoon, I confirmed that privileged administrator authentication events must be kept in immutable storage for exactly 400 days. The current draft rollout plan only keeps the standard 30-day audit-log retention, which falls short of this requirement. I have not yet opened the compliance ticket for this rollout.
transcript.speaker: A4

commitments.detail: Update the rollout ticket with the 10% canary, 14-day optional-mode period, and enforced mode after optional period. Rollout mode set to optional per policy.
Add the 18 contractor accounts to the exception list in the rollout plan, excluding them from enrollment until Wednesday at 09:00.
Open the compliance ticket for this rollout specifying 400-day immutable storage for privileged administrator authentication events.
